widgets.label: Organizations
widgets.description: Every organization with KYC status, people, preset and warnings; search, filters, sorting and paging done by the server.

widgets.label: Sign-in access
widgets.description: Every user’s sign-in links and live sessions; end all of a user’s sessions or disable a sign-in link.

widgets.label: KYC application
widgets.description: An organization's KYC application: status, the schema-driven form, save, submit and withdraw.

widgets.label: KYC applications
widgets.description: Every KYC application you can see: search, status filter, sorting and paging done by the server; picking one opens it.

widgets.label: My KYC status
widgets.description: Where your organization’s KYC application stands and what happens next.

widgets.label: KYC review queue
widgets.description: Open KYC review tasks for the signed-in reviewer, with an approve / reject decision and a note.

widgets.label: Audit trail
widgets.description: Who did what, to which record, and when; newest first.

widgets.label: KYC checks
widgets.description: Identity, sanctions and adverse-media checks on the picked organization, and recording a new one.

widgets.label: What it can do
widgets.description: An organization's features (its portal menus) as switches, with presets and warnings such as "Can't add users".

widgets.label: New administrator
widgets.description: Ask for a new administrator for an organization whose administrator left or lost access.

widgets.label: Organization network
widgets.description: Your organization and every organization below it, with status, people and holds; suspend or lift a hold.

widgets.label: Onboard an organization
widgets.description: One step: fill the new organization’s KYC on five tabs and submit; the org and its administrator are created with it.

widgets.label: Onboarding requests
widgets.description: Organizations and administrator replacements waiting for approval, with an approve / reject decision.

widgets.label: People and roles
widgets.description: An organization's people with the roles they hold; search, filters, sorting and paging done by the server.

widgets.label: Onboarding rights
widgets.description: Which organization types an organization may onboard, and what those may onboard; narrowed from above.

widgets.label: Role ceiling
widgets.description: The roles an organization may use and hand down; set by an organization above it.

widgets.label: Role assignments
widgets.description: Who in the organization holds which role; give a person a role or take one away.

widgets.label: My access
widgets.description: What your roles let you do, widget by widget: View, Create, Modify, Approve (read-only).

widgets.label: New role
widgets.description: Create a role by ticking View, Create, Modify or Approve on every widget of a portal, menu by menu.

menuCells.label: Give ticked submenus their menu cell

widgets.label: All role assignments
widgets.description: Every role assignment on the platform; give any user a role in an organization, or revoke one.

widgets.label: Access reconciliation
widgets.description: Where an organization’s roles in the core and in RBAC disagree, and whether RBAC enforces yet.

widgets.label: Permission catalogue
widgets.description: Every permission row roles are built from, its verbs, the org types it applies to and the endpoints it guards.

widgets.label: Role approvals
widgets.description: Role requests waiting for a second person, with an approve / reject decision.

widgets.label: Roles
widgets.description: Every role, what it allows, and changing or deleting the roles that may be changed.

widgets.label: Organization users
widgets.description: People in your organization, with controls to add a user, issue a setup link, and deactivate access.

widgets.label: Sign-in and sessions
widgets.description: Each person’s sign-in credential; send the set-up link again, reset the credential, or sign them out everywhere.
